name: diff-review
description: Review current diff or specified commit range
instructions: If no argument is given, review `git diff` (unstaged changes)
If a commit range is given (e.g. HEAD~3..HEAD), review those commits
Check for: correctness, security, code style consistency, missing error handling
Verify compatibility with existing types in src/types/index.ts
Check that IndexedDB writes precede context updates
Ensure no secrets or API keys are committed
Provide feedback as a bullet list of issues and suggestions
